mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_notice WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (starts_at IS NULL OR starts_at <= #{now}) AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= #{now}) ORDER BY priority ASC, notice_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_notice (title, content, use_yn, starts_at, ends_at, priority, frst_regr_empno, lst_chgr_empno) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{useYn}, #{startsAt}, #{endsAt}, #{priority}, #{frstRegrEmpno}, #{lstChgrEmpno})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, use_yn = #{useYn}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, priority = #{priority}, lst_chgr_empno = #{lstChgrEmpno}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE notice_no = #{noticeNo}
UPDATE tb_notice SET use_yn = 'N', lst_chgr_empno = #{updatedBy}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE notice_no = #{id}
